texts.en:
We have the ability to manually design new Ships in the Ship Designer screen. This is a fairly straight-forward process, though one that can be fully automated if we so wish.

To access the Ship Designer;

£dot_green£Click the Fleet Management button on the left side bar or press F9

                        £fleet_management£
